index_base.note: 'Fines[0]' and '1st fine' denote the same element

mandatory_vocabulary._: no mandatory column; presence is driven by section titles

date_dialect.source GeneratedAt: MMM d, yyyy, h:mm:ss a, assumed UTC

null_rule: null, empty and missing are equivalent; notes omitted if empty; no null in output
section_semantics: condition in title applies to all rows of the section; one note per section (per element for loops)
